limitations: Same shared host, changing dataset/cache/JIT/time order; one run per phase, no statistical causal proof
Global cumulative concurrent timer seconds are not additive wall-clock latency; MISC is not fsync-only
Explicit COMMIT excludes autocommits; fsync counters are separate and may overlap
Commit-stage/log-lock instruments disabled: unavailable, not zero
Endpoint config/reset checks cannot prove no transient changes between snapshots
Health aggregate API took about4.3seconds; experiment probe15seconds only, business timeouts unchanged
Backend/frontend unchanged; no full backend/browser rebuild this step; remote CI not executed
